dialogue.content: こんにわ相談員です。宜しくお願いします
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm the counselor. Nice to meet you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Nice to meet you too.

dialogue.content: 今日はどんなご相談でしたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 自分の仕事のことで悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm struggling with something at work.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、それは重要なことですね。。
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds important.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お仕事のどのようなお悩みですか？
dialogue.English: What specific concerns do you have about your work?

dialogue.content: 何からお伝えしたらよいのか
dialogue.English: I'm not sure where to start.

dialogue.content: これまでと職場が変わり
dialogue.English: My workplace has changed from what it used to be,

dialogue.content: はい、ゆっくりどうぞ
dialogue.English: Of course, please take your time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 働きにくくなりまして
dialogue.English: It's become harder for me to work there.

dialogue.content: それは悩ましいですね
dialogue.English: That sounds troubling.

dialogue.content: どうように、働きにくくなったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: In what ways has it become difficult to work?

dialogue.content: ここの職場でなくてもよいかなと
dialogue.English: I'm starting to think that maybe I don't need to be at this workplace.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そのように考えちゃうわけですねー
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのように、、
dialogue.English: In what ways...

dialogue.content: 働きにくくなったのか、、
dialogue.English: ...has it become difficult to work...

dialogue.content: 教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more?

dialogue.content: これまでは違う店舗で仕事をしていたのですが
dialogue.English: I used to work at a different store, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: コロナの影響で違う店舗に移ることになりまして
dialogue.English: Due to the impact of COVID, I was transferred to a different store.

dialogue.content: 職場の環境が変わりました
dialogue.English: The work environment has changed.

dialogue.content: はい、コロナ禍での異動は大変ですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, transferring during the pandemic must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、職場の環境がどのように変わったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. In what ways has the work environment changed?

dialogue.content: 一緒に働くメンバーが変わり
dialogue.English: The people I work with have changed,

dialogue.content: はい、そうですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, that makes sense.

dialogue.content: 店舗が変わったことよりも人間関係ですね
dialogue.English: It's more about the interpersonal relationships than the change of store itself.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お仕事の内容とか、やり方も変わった感じでっすか？
dialogue.English: Does it also feel like the content of the work or the way you do things has changed?

dialogue.content: 仕事の内容は同じですが
dialogue.English: The content of the work is the same, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 店舗が変わってやり方は変わったと思います
dialogue.English: I think the way of doing things has changed with the change of store.

dialogue.content: なるほど、ただでさえコロナで精神的に大変な中、異動で人間関係や仕事のやり方が変わるって、相当ご苦労されてますよね
dialogue.English: I understand. It must be quite a hardship for you, with the mental toll of the pandemic on top of having to deal with new relationships and work methods due to the transfer.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 好きな仕事が嫌になりそうです
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm starting to dislike the job I love.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、それは寂しい感じですね
dialogue.English: I see... that must feel disheartening.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、、
dialogue.English: By the way...

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: どのような店舗をやられてるのか、何名くらいでお店をやってらっしゃるのか、
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what kind of store it is, and about how many staff work there?

dialogue.content: と、えだまめこさんの立場も教えていただけませんか？
dialogue.English: And could you also tell me your position, Ms. Edamameko?

dialogue.content: どのような店舗ですか？
dialogue.English: What do you mean by 'what kind of store'?

dialogue.content: はい、、業種など
dialogue.English: Yes, the type of business.

dialogue.content: エステ関連で、スタッフは10名程度です
dialogue.English: It's in the esthetics field, with about 10 staff members.

dialogue.content: 私は違う店舗の店長で
dialogue.English: I was the manager of a different store.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、エステ店さんは需要が多く、お忙しいですよね、、
dialogue.English: I see. Esthetic salons are in high demand, so you must be busy.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、店長さんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so you're a store manager.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: すみません、、違う店舗の店長・・・とは？
dialogue.English: Excuse me, what do you mean by 'the manager of a different store'?

dialogue.content: 現在ホテルが休業中で違う店舗に移って働いています
dialogue.English: The hotel is currently closed, so I've moved to a different store to work.

dialogue.content: 本来はホテル内に店舗があります
dialogue.English: Normally, our store is located inside a hotel.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、有難うございます。いまは臨時的に、違う店舗にいってらっしゃるわけですね
dialogue.English: I see, thank you. So you're temporarily working at a different store right now.

dialogue.content: そうなのです
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: そうしますと、、
dialogue.English: In that case...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 人間関係と、仕事のやり方と、に今、違和感を感じてらっしゃるわけですね＞
dialogue.English: So, you're currently feeling a sense of unease with the personal relationships and the work methods, is that correct?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 他にも、、気になる事とかございますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else that's bothering you?

dialogue.content: 恐らくその辺がモヤモヤしている原因だと思うのですが
dialogue.English: I think those are probably the reasons for my sense of unease.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: これまで感じたことのないモヤモヤで
dialogue.English: It's a kind of unease I've never felt before.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、初めての感覚なのですね
dialogue.English: I see, so it's a new feeling for you.

dialogue.content: せっかく好きで始めた仕事なのに
dialogue.English: Even though I started this job because I love it...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 嫌いになりそうで
dialogue.English: I'm afraid I'm going to start hating it.

dialogue.content: それも嫌な感じです
dialogue.English: And I hate that feeling, too.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、それほどの思いになってらっしゃるのですね
dialogue.English: I see... so you're feeling that strongly about it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ため息ばかりです
dialogue.English: I just keep sighing.

dialogue.content: その初めての感覚のモヤモヤは、どんな時にそう感じられますか？
dialogue.English: When do you tend to feel that unfamiliar sense of unease?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Let me see...

dialogue.content: 仕事をしているときは
dialogue.English: When I'm at work,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 気持ちよくしようと思いまして
dialogue.English: I try to keep my spirits up,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: モヤモヤ感じないのですが
dialogue.English: so I don't feel that unease.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、それは少し良かったです
dialogue.English: I see... that's good to hear, at least.

dialogue.content: 自宅に帰ってきて思い返してモヤモヤになります
dialogue.English: It's when I get home and think back on the day that the unease comes back.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、辛い感じですね
dialogue.English: I see... that sounds difficult.

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is.

dialogue.content: それはどのくらいの周期でそう考えますか？
dialogue.English: How often do you find yourself thinking that way?

dialogue.content: 最近は毎日のようにです
dialogue.English: Lately, it's been almost every day.

dialogue.content: やはり
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そんなにですか、それはお疲れになりますね
dialogue.English: That often? That must be exhausting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はじめはそれほどではなく
dialogue.English: At first, it wasn't so bad,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 他の店舗のスタッフとリズムが合わないのかなと思っています
dialogue.English: I think maybe I'm just not in sync with the staff at the other store.

dialogue.content: 波長みたいな
dialogue.English: Like we're not on the same wavelength.

dialogue.content: なるほどですね、、そう感じてらっしゃるわけですね、波長ですか・・・
dialogue.English: I see... so that's how you feel. Not on the same wavelength...

dialogue.content: 同じ店舗のスタッフとは息があっているのですが
dialogue.English: I get along perfectly with the staff from my own store, but...

dialogue.content: 波長の他に、何か違和感とか、感じたことございますか？
dialogue.English: Besides not being on the same wavelength, have you felt anything else that seems off?

dialogue.content: 同じ職場の仲間とはいえ
dialogue.English: Even though we're colleagues at the same workplace...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: お互いに気持ちよく働くため気は遣うと思うのですが
dialogue.English: I think we should be considerate of each other in order to have a pleasant work environment.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、、そう思います
dialogue.English: Yes, I agree.

dialogue.content: 色々勝手だなと思いまして
dialogue.English: I feel like they're selfish in various ways.

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 例えば、、どんなのございますか？
dialogue.English: For example, what kinds of things?

dialogue.content: そういうことってなかなか伝えられないですし
dialogue.English: It's hard to tell people things like that.

dialogue.content: ですいよね、、言いにくいですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, it is... It's difficult to say, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 細かいことですが
dialogue.English: It's a small thing, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お客様を迎える前は
dialogue.English: Before we welcome a client,

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Mm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 前の方の後片付けや消毒作業を徹底しているのですが
dialogue.English: we are thorough about cleaning up and disinfecting after the previous person.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナ禍ですしね
dialogue.English: Especially during the pandemic.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 仕事が雑で
dialogue.English: Some of them are sloppy with their work,

dialogue.content: なるほど
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 変わりに他のスタッフがしていることに気付かない者もいます
dialogue.English: and some of them don't even notice that other staff members are covering for them.

dialogue.content: 輪を乱す感じです
dialogue.English: It feels like they're disrupting the harmony of the team.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、全員いい加減なわけじゃない感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see, so it's not that everyone is careless?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 普段一緒に働いているスタッフは
dialogue.English: The staff I usually work with...

dialogue.content: なるほど、、話を乱す人は何名くらいですか？
dialogue.English: I see. About how many people are disrupting the harmony?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 輪、でした
dialogue.English: Harmony, I meant.

dialogue.content: 輪を乱すスタッフは
dialogue.English: The staff who disrupt the harmony...

dialogue.content: 今来ている店舗のスタッフで2名です
dialogue.English: are two of the staff members at the store where I am now.

dialogue.content: 普段一緒に働いているスタッフは心地よいメンバーです
dialogue.English: The staff I usually work with are a pleasant group to be around.

dialogue.content: はい、有難うございます。先ほど話を途中で折ってしまいました。すみません、続けてください。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I'm sorry for interrupting you earlier. Please continue.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いいえ
dialogue.English: Oh, not at all.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: It's fine.

dialogue.content: 他にもございますか？
dialogue.English: Is there anything else?

dialogue.content: あるかもしれませんが
dialogue.English: There might be, but...

dialogue.content: 忘れているので
dialogue.English: I've forgotten, so...

dialogue.content: 他は大したことはなかったと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think anything else was a big deal.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、細かいことも含めれば、相当いっぱいありそうな感じまのですね
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like there would be quite a lot if we included all the small things.

dialogue.content: 有難うございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: これらのことは、これまでどなたかに相談されたりしてましたか？
dialogue.English: Have you talked to anyone about these things before?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今いる店舗の店長に
dialogue.English: The manager of the store I'm currently at.

dialogue.content: 教えていただけますか？どなたでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me who that was?

dialogue.content: それとなく話しました
dialogue.English: I mentioned it to them indirectly.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、それは良かったです。。その店長さんは何とおっしゃってましたか？
dialogue.English: I see, that's good. What did the manager say?

dialogue.content: おおめにみてよ
dialogue.English: To just overlook it.

dialogue.content: と言われました
dialogue.English: That's what I was told.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そうおっしゃてたんですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's what they said.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ということは、、
dialogue.English: So that means...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その店長さんも不具合には気付いてらっしゃるわけですよね
dialogue.English: that the manager is also aware of the problem, right?

dialogue.content: たぶん
dialogue.English: Probably.

dialogue.content: なるほど、、少し気になりますね・・・
dialogue.English: I see... that's a bit concerning.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しつれいですが、、
dialogue.English: Excuse me for asking, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: エステ店さんって、
dialogue.English: Regarding esthetic salons,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一般のお客様向けに展開されてるのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: are they open to the general public?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: だとしたら、、
dialogue.English: If that's the case...

dialogue.content: お客様にもしその雑さがバレたら、、どうなりますか？
dialogue.English: what would happen if customers were to notice that sloppiness?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Right.

dialogue.content: そうなんです
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: その店長はいつも
dialogue.English: That manager is always...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 他のスタッフとフォローしているようです
dialogue.English: ...seems to be covering for those staff members, along with others.

dialogue.content: お客様には人気のようで
dialogue.English: They seem to be popular with customers,

dialogue.content: なるほど、、そんな事までしなきゃいけない感じなのですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see... so it's gotten to the point where you have to do that.

dialogue.content: 人気？？とは、
dialogue.English: Popular? What do you mean by that?

dialogue.content: 顧客がついているみたいです
dialogue.English: It seems they have a lot of regular customers.

dialogue.content: その問題のスタッフさんですか？
dialogue.English: You mean the problematic staff members?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なるほど・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 売上が多いみたいで
dialogue.English: Apparently, they bring in a lot of sales.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、なので店長さんも気を使ってるかんじでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see... so is that why the manager is being so lenient with them?

dialogue.content: 店長は面倒見が良くて
dialogue.English: The manager is very caring,

dialogue.content: なるほど、、それじゃあえだまめこさんもモヤモヤしちゃいますよね
dialogue.English: I see... then it's no wonder you feel so uneasy.

dialogue.content: はい 私のように思わないみたいです
dialogue.English: Yes. It seems they don't see it the way I do.

dialogue.content: ん・・・・・なるほどですね
dialogue.English: Hmm... I understand.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ここまでいろいろお話しお伺いし、、
dialogue.English: Now that I've heard everything you've shared...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 話して頂いてありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing all of this with me.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございます
dialogue.English: No, thank you.

dialogue.content: 少し私が感じた事をお伝えさせて頂いて宜しいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I shared some of my thoughts on what you've told me?

dialogue.content: お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 問題あるスタッフさんですが、
dialogue.English: Regarding the problematic staff members...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その仕事の雑さがまだお客様に伝わってないのでいいと思うのですが、
dialogue.English: I think it's good that their sloppiness hasn't reached the customers yet, but...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: もし何らかの瞬間にお客様に気づかれてしまうと、
dialogue.English: if at some point a customer were to notice,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一瞬にして顧客が離れていくことになりませんか？
dialogue.English: wouldn't you lose customers in an instant?

dialogue.content: そう思っています
dialogue.English: I believe so.

dialogue.content: ですよね、、それに今の時代、ネットに書き込まれ炎上したり、
dialogue.English: Right... and in this day and age, something could be posted online and go viral...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 誹謗中傷が広がったり
dialogue.English: and slander could spread.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 恐ろしいことになりかねませんよね、と感じます。
dialogue.English: I feel it could lead to terrible consequences.

dialogue.content: そのとおりです
dialogue.English: That's exactly right.

dialogue.content: なので、えだまめこさんが心配され、モヤモヤされるのも当然と思います
dialogue.English: So, I think it's completely natural for you to be worried and feel uneasy.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: であれば、、今のうちに、
dialogue.English: In that case, while there's still time...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 直すことがやはり重要ではないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: isn't it important to address this?

dialogue.content: そのためには、、
dialogue.English: And to do that...

dialogue.content: その店長さんに、、ネット炎上の可能性なども話され、
dialogue.English: perhaps you could talk to the manager about the possibility of online backlash...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: お客様にキチンとした対応をするよう、えだまめこさんから進言し、
dialogue.English: and suggest from your end that they ensure proper customer service,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 一緒に改善に取り組まれたらいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: and how about working together to improve the situation?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: That makes sense.

dialogue.content: と思いました。
dialogue.English: That's what I thought.

dialogue.content: そういう話は伝えていませんでした
dialogue.English: I hadn't mentioned that side of it.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: えだまめこさんの感覚は当然です
dialogue.English: Your feelings are perfectly valid.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 店長とは話せるので伝えてみます
dialogue.English: I have a good rapport with the manager, so I'll try telling her.

dialogue.content: はい、そうされた方が良いかと思います。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think that would be for the best.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ぜひ、近々話されてみてください。その結果、また可能であれば教えていただければ、また相談させて頂きたいと思います。
dialogue.English: Please do try to talk to her soon. If you can, let me know how it goes, and we can discuss it further.

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: モヤモヤが
dialogue.English: My sense of unease...

dialogue.content: 溶けた気がします
dialogue.English: ...I feel like it has melted away.

dialogue.content: はい、それは良かったです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm very glad to hear that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こちらこそ、有難うございました。
dialogue.English: No, thank you as well.

dialogue.content: それでは今日もご相談はこの辺で宜しかったでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Well then, shall we conclude our session for today?

dialogue.content: はいありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.

dialogue.content: 有難うございした。お疲れさまでした！
dialogue.English: Thank you. Take care!

dialogue.content: お疲れさまでした。
dialogue.English: Thank you. You too.

dialogue.content: では、ここで終了させて頂きます
dialogue.English: Then, I will end the session here.
